hero.heading:
Your City,
Our City.
hero.body: Blythswood & Broomielaw Community Council gives residents and workers a democratic voice in shaping the heart of Glasgow.

ourArea.heading: The Commercial Heart of Glasgow
ourArea.body1: We cover the dense, layered area between the M8 and Queen Street — home to Blythswood Square, the financial district, Central Station, the River Clyde. A district where thousands of people who live, work and pass through every day.
ourArea.body2: As a statutory Community Council, we have a right to be consulted on planning, licensing and policy decisions that affect our area. We amplify the voices of those who use this city.

pillars.heading: Planning & Licensing
pillars.body: Statutory consultee on applications that reshape our streets.

pillars.heading: Public Realm
pillars.body: Greening lanes, improving footpaths, reducing clutter.

pillars.heading: Night-time Economy
pillars.body: Backing venues, culture, and a thriving evening city.

pillars.heading: Heritage
pillars.body: Protecting the Victorian grid and built character.

ideaCard.heading: Have an idea?
ideaCard.body: Tell us about issues in your neighbourhood that we should prioritise.

jag.heading: Working Together Across Glasgow
jag.body: Through the Joint Action Group (JAG), we team up with neighbouring community councils to channel community voices directly to Glasgow City Council — because some challenges can only be solved together.

getInvolved.heading: Your City. Your Say.
getInvolved.body: Community Councils only work when the community shows up. Here's how to make your voice count.

cards.heading: Attend a Meeting
cards.body: Our public meetings are open to all. Come along, ask questions, and help set our agenda.

cards.heading: Join the Committee
cards.body: Elections are held annually. Become an elected member and help steer the work of the council.

meetings.heading: Coming to a Meeting
meetings.body: All meetings are held in public. No registration required. Agendas published one week in advance.

newsletter.heading: Stay in the Loop
newsletter.body: For occasional updates on meetings, consultations, and planning decisions that affect your city centre. The button opens a pre-filled email; send it as it is, and confirm if you are asked to.
newsletter.subtext: No spam. Unsubscribe any time. Or email updates+subscribe@bbcc.scot from your own mail app.

instagram.heading: Find Us on Instagram
instagram.body: Follow us on Instagram @bbccglasgow for updates from the heart of Glasgow city centre.
